items.docs: Creates a database as a subpage of the specified parent page, with the specified properties schema. A database can be created with a title, properties defining the schema, and an optional description. The parent must be a page that the integration has access to.

params.name: database_id
params.description: The ID of the database to retrieve.

items.docs: Retrieves a Database object using the ID specified in the path. Returns the database properties schema and metadata.

params.name: database_id
params.description: The ID of the database to update.

items.docs: Updates an existing database's title, description, or properties schema. Only the fields specified in the request body will be updated. To remove a property from the schema, set its value to null.

params.name: database_id
params.description: The ID of the database to query.

params.name: filter_properties
params.description: A list of property IDs to include in the response. Only the specified properties will be returned for each page.

items.docs: Gets a list of Pages and/or Databases contained in the database, filtered and ordered according to the filter and sort conditions specified in the request body. Responses are paginated and limited to 100 results per request.
